title: weather tight storage tubs
text: weather tight storage tubs. I actually have several sizes of these - this size is my favorite.  Can't make it so full I can't lift it.  The 'weather tight' - is a foam gasket inside the lid and the nice locking edge pieces.  Nice to keep critters out.  These are really great.  A good size... and stack nicely - however, be aware, they don't lock as they stack.  The clear box is nice because you can see what's in there.  I just can't seem to find these locally.  So... I order here - delivered to my front door.  You get 6 tubs, 6 lids.  They are pretty heavy duty - but if you drop from  a distance - they can crack.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
